facts.business: Sundaram-Clayton Limited manufactures automotive components including die-casting and machined parts for two-wheeler and commercial vehicle segments, and has recently monetized surplus land assets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Class 8 truck market is expected to recover by 8-10% in FY2026–27

key_risks: Customer preference shift from die-casting to machined components
facts.related_party_note: Purchases from related parties: Rs 884.47 crore (FY2026); Remuneration and contribution paid to related parties; Dividend income from related party
